name: Ninja Creami Vanilla Ice Cream
desc: The reliable base. Cream cheese is what keeps it smooth instead of icy
steps: Cream the base: Microwave 1 tablespoon cream cheese, softened and 1/3 cup granulated sugar together for about 10 seconds  , then whisk into a smooth paste.
Mix in liquids: Add 1 cup whole milk, 3/4 cup heavy cream, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, and 1 pinch salt. Whisk until the sugar is fully dissolved.
Freeze flat: Pour into a Creami pint container, seal, and freeze on a level surface for 24 hours.
Spin: Run the Ice Cream setting on your fully frozen pint.
Respin and add mix-ins: If it looks crumbly, run Re-spin once. To add chips or cookies, bore a hole in the center, add them, and run the Mix-In setting.
